title: Capital Gains Taxation Rules for Equity and Debt Mutual Funds
source: Income Tax Act 1961 & Finance Act Amendments
content: Capital Gains Taxation framework: 1. Equity Mutual Funds (≥65% equity allocation): Holding period > 12 months is Long-Term (LTCG taxed at 12.5% above ₹1.25L exemption); ≤ 12 months is Short-Term (STCG taxed at 20%). 2. Debt Mutual Funds: Capital gains from specified debt mutual funds acquired on or after April 1, 2023 are taxed as short-term capital gains at applicable slab rates regardless of holding period.
